PZZ700-170930-
110 PM PST Mon Nov 16 2026

.Synopsis for the far Southern CA coast...
At 1 PM, a 1010 mb low was near Lake Tahoe and a 1032 mb high 
located 1400 nautical miles west of Point Conception, CA. Winds 
and seas will become hazardous this afternoon and evening. 25-30 
kt gusts expected, with steep, high seas of 8-10 feet. A break in
hazardous conditions can be expected Wednesday. Conditions look 
to deteriorate once again come Thursday afternoon as the next 
storm system approaches. There is a 10-15 percent chance of 
thunderstorms over the coastal waters from into Tuesday morning. 
If any thunderstorms occur, they will be capable of producing 
gusty/erratic winds up to 50 kts and lightning, with a slim chance
of an isolated waterspout.

$$
